description:
Check a wallet's balances on Base, Ethereum or Solana: native ETH or SOL, USDC (plus USDT on Ethereum and Solana), and any token contracts or SPL mints you list (up to 20), with symbols and decimals applied. Read live from the chain.

$0.002 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote. The first 3 calls a day through this tool server are free (no wallet needed).

When to use: You need what a wallet holds, in token amounts.
Use instead: wallet_portfolio for USD values and a total; check_my_balance (free) for your own USDC on Base.
Parameters: address is required. chain: base (default), ethereum or solana; the address format must match. tokens: up to 20 extra ERC-20 contracts or SPL mints to include.
Returns: native coin, USDC (USDT on Ethereum and Solana) and the tokens you listed, each with symbol, decimals and amount.

address.description: 0x address on Base/Ethereum, or base58 address on Solana.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

tokens.description: Extra ERC-20 contracts (SPL mints on Solana) to include.

name: wallet_balance
title: Wallet balance
